observations.name: duplicate-field
observations.remaining: Owner must enforce field/column identity uniqueness.

observations.name: duplicate-carrier
observations.remaining: Owner must enforce one declaration per type while retaining actual scans.

observations.name: 64-byte-16-character-identifier
observations.remaining: Owner UTF8 byte check must refuse 64 bytes.

observations.name: logical-string-NUL-allowed-value

observations.name: out-of-int64-discriminator

observations.name: incoherent-length-refinement
